title: ICMPv6 header
summary: ICMPv6 is the IPv6 equivalent of ICMP. Header: type (1 byte), code (1 byte), checksum (2 bytes), then type-specific data. Common types: 128 echo request, 129 echo reply, 133 router solicitation, 134 router advertisement, 135 neighbor solicitation, 136 neighbor advertisement, 137 redirect.

ext.summary: ICMPv6 is the IPv6 equivalent of ICMP. Header: type (1 byte), code (1 byte), checksum (2 bytes), then type-specific data. Common types: 128 echo request, 129 echo reply, 133 router solicitation, 134 router advertisement, 135 neighbor solicitation, 136 neighbor advertisement, 137 redirect.

structure.meaning: 128 echo request, 129 echo reply, 133 router solicitation, 134 router advertisement, 135 neighbor solicitation, 136 neighbor advertisement, 137 redirect, 1 (dest unreachable), 2 (packet too big), 3 (time exceeded), 4 (parameter problem).
Sub-type (e.g., 0 = no route, 1 = admin prohibited, 2 = beyond scope, 3 = address unreachable, 4 = port unreachable for dest unreachable).
ICMPv6 checksum (covers the ICMPv6 message + IPv6 pseudo-header).
Type-specific data (e.g., identifier + sequence number for echo, or neighbor address for NS/NA).

ext.example_decoded: ICMPv6 echo request (type 128), code 0, id 1, seq 1, payload 'Hello'
notes: ICMPv6 is required for IPv6 (no ARP; uses NDP for neighbor resolution).
Neighbor Discovery Protocol (NDP) replaces ARP in IPv6.
Router Solicitation/Advertisement (RS/RA) replaces DHCP for router discovery.
ICMPv6 checksum includes the IPv6 pseudo-header (src addr, dst addr, length, next header).
